snippet.title: Crystals Of Irm Release Window Announcement
snippet.description:
Deck 13 Spotlight and developer David Schütze are thrilled to invite all the RPG fans to the beautiful world of Crystals Of Irm later this year! As brave heroes: fighter, mage, and ranger. The party will test their might exploring dangerous dungeons, and explore the vast lands of Irm with its cities, villages, and towns (in first-person 3D!) full of citizens awaiting the players' assistance! A complex combat system makes the gameplay challenging but never unfair.

Wishlist now!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971470/Crystals_Of_Irm/
